title: Edgar Fouche's 1998 TR-3B testimony: projects moved to Dugway

tellings.quote: super weird meta thing. Whoa. But even like Edgar Fuche, whose primary testimony in 1998 revolves around um the TR3B talks about hey you know a lot of projects were moved out to Dougway proven route.

plain: A man named Edgar Fouche gave testimony in 1998 that centred on the TR-3B, a rumoured secret triangle-shaped aircraft, and in it he said many secret projects were moved out to Dugway Proving Ground, an Army test range in Utah. The online researcher known as UAPGerb points to this when he talks with Michels about how hidden programmes are run. He uses it as one more account placing such work at Dugway.
